reason: £280 is close to what I'd pay for a decent used set on Marketplace or eBay, and I can check those myself. A refurbished set from a seller with no reviews doesn't give me a reason to switch.
objection: Refurbished wheels hide problems under the paint. Photos and a balancer report from a brand-new seller with no reviews don't prove much, and I can find similar used sets for less.
would_change_my_mind: A set of my exact fitment at about £200 that I can inspect on collection, or a few real reviews from local buyers.
